enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Conflagrating: This weapon is sheathed in furious flame. A conflagrating weapon deals an extra 3 to 18 points of fire damage on a successful hit.

Greater Incineration: This weapon stores the power of a raging inferno deep within. Occasionally, this destructive power comes to the surface, devastating enemies with massive fire damage. This damage will be dealt more often than a standard Incineration weapon.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
